note: Both sets capture the core Nitinol facts (composition, contraction, strain, crystal phases, hysteresis, transition temperatures) with supporting quotes, and both repeat claims (A duplicates the 70C and 15-30C items; B duplicates the Ni/Ti composition and 2-5% contraction items). B adds two substantive claims A misses — the linear actuation capability at low induced energy and the Nitinol-actuated linear diffuser function with its passive heated-air actuation condition. Both misread footnote 3 by reporting only 70C where the source says '70C and 90C', and B additionally drops 'upwards of' from the 25,000 PSI force. B's broader, faithful coverage of the built-environment application tips the comparison despite its redundancy.
